subject: Founder program credits — scope and usage constraints
messages:
From: Lina Park <lina@orbitstart.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request — accelerator cohort credit top-up and extension

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the intro last week — OrbitStart is wrapping up our first demo week for the summer cohort and we ran into a timing/concurrency issue with our current trial credits. A few of the teams (3 startups) hit heavier-than-expected generation usage during live testing and we’re at risk of throttling before tomorrow’s investor office hours.

Quick ask: would Redwood consider a short, conditional top-up and extension to cover the cohort through July 31st? Ideally we’d get an additional ~75k token credit that can be used across the shared accelerator account, with an expiration shift to 2028-07-31.

We’re happy to provide a short milestone report (one-pager) and link Redwood as a technology partner in our demo slide deck. If you need cohort details (team names, expected monthly tokens per team, or whether usage was embeddings vs. generation) I can send that.

Appreciate any help — we want to avoid any interruptions for the startups and this is a small but high-impact ask.

Best,
Lina Park
Head of Programs, OrbitStart
cohort@orbitstart.com

Attachments: accelerator_milestones.pdf (stub)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Lina Park <lina@orbitstart.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-29T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request — accelerator cohort credit top-up and extension

Hi Lina — thanks for the note and context.

This is something we can often support for accelerator partners. To move quickly I need two small things from you:
1) a short breakdown (one table or the pilot-scope.xlsx attached) showing which teams used generation vs embeddings and rough token counts per team for the last 7 days;
2) confirmation that OrbitStart will include Redwood as a partner in the external demo materials (logo + one sentence).

I’ve looped in Marissa (credits & programs) so she can review the ask and confirm the top-up and the exact amount. If you can send the breakdown I’ll try to get a decision this afternoon.

—Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Partnerships, Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Lina Park <lina@orbitstart.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-29T12:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request — accelerator cohort credit top-up and extension

Hi Lina + Naomi —

Thanks for the context. We can approve a conditional top-up for accelerator partners when there’s a clear usage pattern and a small mutual-commitment from the program. Proposed approval:

- Top-up: 75,000 tokens (applies to the OrbitStart shared accelerator account)
- Validity: extended to 2028-07-31 (non-renewing)
- Conditions: OrbitStart will provide the two items Naomi requested (usage breakdown + partner mention in demo materials) and submit a one-pager milestone report by 2028-07-10 describing what the credits enabled (teams & outcomes).
- Reporting: Marissa will validate the milestone report and mark the HubSpot deal DEAL-8342 as the redemption source.

I’ve attached our standard sponsorship terms for accelerator credits — no legal redlines expected for a grant of this size, but please review.

If OrbitStart needs a different token cap model (e.g., per-team allotments or a concurrency cap) let us know and Karthik can propose a recommended guardrail in a quick follow-up.

Marissa Cole
Senior Programs Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Lina Park <lina@orbitstart.com>
Date: 2028-06-29T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request — accelerator cohort credit top-up and extension

Quick operational note from infra side — good to approve but recommend we set two simple guardrails on the account to avoid accidental over-consumption:

- Monthly token cap for the shared account: 75,000 tokens (enforced server-side)
- Max concurrent requests: 8 (keeps latency predictable for demo load)

If OrbitStart later asks to convert this into a recurring program allocation we’ll need a short MOU; but for this one-off top-up these runtime limits should be enough. I can push the quota change once Marissa confirms the amount in HubSpot.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Infrastructure & Product Ops, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Request — accelerator cohort credit top-up and extension

Hi Naomi / Marissa / Karthik —

This is great news — thank you. We accept the 75,000 token top-up and the 2028-07-31 extension with the conditions you listed. I’ve attached the one-pager milestone template and will circulate the short usage breakdown by EOD tomorrow. OrbitStart is happy to include Redwood’s logo and a one-line partner acknowledgement in our demo materials; I’ll share the final slide with Naomi when it’s ready.

Can we schedule a 20-minute onboarding call for Tuesday (2028-07-02) to confirm the shared account settings and the quota guardrails Karthik mentioned? I’m available 11–2 PT.

Thanks again — this will keep the cohort demos smooth.

Best,
Lina Park
Head of Programs, OrbitStart
cohort@orbitstart.com
